description_en: Queries DCDN accelerated domain names by specified origin servers
name: DescribeDcdnDomainsBySource

parameters.description_en: The origin servers. You can specify up to 20 origin servers. Separate multiple origin servers with commas (,). Fuzzy matching is not supported.
parameters.description_zh: 源站列表，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多20个，不支持模糊匹配。
